pattern: offer a predictable handoff alongside an unresolved decision
experience: A maintainer wants to launch routine work from a card while leaving a policy decision open for discussion.

setup.context: Both queue items belong to the registered project app. The filter pull request is on origin/filters. The scan window decision has no agreed answer.

prompt: Show me two task cards. For the filters PR the next step is to fix the review findings and draft replies. For the scan window I need to choose between 30 and 90 days. I'll decide what to start.
